NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.47 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.47
• 新增功能中心，自行添加或移除侧栏入口；升级保留已使用的工具，移除入口不删除内容和设置。 • 统一灯光与演奏作品库，支持全部、灯光、演奏筛选；可直接添加所需编辑工具，继续编辑原作品。 • 新增键盘口袋：用九个本地槽位收纳和取用文字、图片、链接与文件，支持撤销和独立快捷键设置。 • 快捷键可点击后按键录制；口袋预览从屏幕顶部刘海区域展开，支持关闭预览后直接取用。 • 改进文件粘贴与访问恢复；文件夹可复制为 ZIP，保留中文文件名，便于粘贴到聊天软件。 • 修复连续按下、松开快捷键时口袋浮窗偶尔不出现的问题。 • 改进口袋取用时切换应用的取消保护，以及与智能框选和 Fn 按键的冲突处理。 • 框选提问更名为智能框选，翻译、总结、解释、回复可自行勾选，滚轮只切换已启用的动作。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.47
• Add Feature Center to customize sidebar entries. Upgrades keep previously used tools; removing an entry preserves its content and settings. • Bring lighting and music into one Library with All, Lighting and Music filters. Add the needed editor and continue editing the original work. • Add Keyboard Pocket: store and retrieve text, images, links and files in nine local slots, with Undo and separate shortcut settings. • Record shortcuts by clicking and pressing keys. Pocket previews unfold from the screen notch; direct retrieval also works with previews off. • Improve file pasting and access recovery. Copy folders as ZIP archives with Chinese filenames preserved for pasting into chat apps. • Fix Pocket previews occasionally failing to appear after repeated shortcut presses and releases. • Improve cancellation when switching apps during Pocket retrieval, and handle conflicts with Smart Selection and Fn keys. • Rename Ask about a selection to Smart Selection. Choose which Translate, Summarize, Explain and Reply actions to enable; scrolling skips disabled actions.
